BackgroundEvidence of the effectiveness and cost-effectiveness of new vaccines that reduce the burden of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) in older populations is emerging. The reported cost-effectiveness of these vaccination strategies varies substantially across different settings. This study assessed the cost-effectiveness of older adult-targeted RSV vaccination strategies in the Australian context and compared findings with published evaluations.
